items.title: How Many Shares of Kimberly-Clark, Clorox or Procter & Gamble Pay $1,000 a Month in Dividends?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAt today’s prices, a hypothetical retiree needs 2,400 Clorox shares (about $262,700), 2,344 Kimberly-Clark shares (about $256,500) or 2,759 Procter & Gamble shares (about $468,500) to collect $1,000 a month in dividends. Procter & Gamble’s check costs the most by far, but its dividend took just 67% of free cash flow over the 12 months to Sept.
